use.flag: Make the tray icon toggle the main window on left click (show when hidden, hide when visible), like Viber. Works natively on the Electron 44 runtime (0.5.4-r1): its SNI tray implements the Activate method. On the legacy 0.5.4 ebuild (Electron 17 + libappindicator) left clicks never reach the app, so there the flag is inert and the right-click menu is the interaction.
